package.name: camera_capture
package.description: Capture of the cell's cameras (V4L2) with recording in the same process: the ELP as HEVC through ffmpeg (hevc_nvenc) with the MJPG AVI fallback, borescopes as mp4, frame CSVs in the legacy columns; image and preview topics, and a 2x2 preview window (port of the legacy elp.py, borescope.py and elp_hevc.py).
